_scenario_comment: Desk scenario: single Franka, no pan/tilt head device, video comes from the fixed 'desk_cam' in the simulator's sim_config_franka_desk.yaml. Select this file by setting "overlay": "overlay_desk.json" in config.json (same indirection already used for robot/stream/network). Everything below is identical to overlay.json except the viewpoint block and capture FOV.
_viewpoint_comment: STATIC viewpoint. pos/look_at are copied verbatim from the 'desk_cam' entry in the simulator's config/sim_config_franka_desk.yaml -- if you move the camera there, mirror it here or the overlay will be wrong in a way that looks like a bug in the ghost math. (Stage 2 removes this duplication by having the avatar send its extrinsics + fovy over the reliable UDP link at startup.) The head_tracked block is kept populated so switching back is a one-word edit to "mode".
_capture_fov_comment: HORIZONTAL FOV in degrees; MuJoCo gives VERTICAL fovy, so hfov = 2*atan(tan(fovy/2) * width/height). desk_cam is set to fovy=60 at 1280x960 to match the head cams (~RealSense-class optics) -> 2*atan(tan(30)*4/3) = 75.2. If you change desk_cam's fovy in the sim, recompute this. stereo_* values are unused here: a single fixed camera has one viewpoint, so the ghost is forced to mono (see GhostOverlayComponent::BeginPlay) and the stream config should have "stereo": false.
_quad_comment: Face-locked quad geometry, shared by the ghost overlay layer AND the video layer (and read by gaze projection). Keep these in sync with whatever the video is sized against. hmd_hfov_deg is the headset's horizontal FOV -- ~110 for Vive Pro / Pro Eye. These describe the HEADSET, not the scene camera, so they do not change between scenarios.
